translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Itsinampashirenka eejatzi ririiperonka Cristo
Iri Cristo oimoshirenkaimiri, tema retakotakemi, risaikashiretantakemi Itasorenka, piyotairo pineshironkatawakagaawo,
paapatziyawakaayetaiya, petakotawakaayetaiya, oshiyawaityaawo apaanime onkantaiya pikenkithashiretanewo. Iroowa oimoshirenkaanari.

Arika ontzime oita panteri, eero pikisawakaawentawo, tsinampashireri pinkantya, eero pasagaawentawaitawo. Te opantawo pinkantante: “Naaka kameethaperotatsi, te ompantyaari jirinta.” Iroowa kameethatatsi pinkante: “Iri kameethaperotatsi jirinta, ranaakena naaka.”
Te apatziro onkameethate pineshironkatya eeroka, ontzimatye pineshironkayetairi eejatzi itsipapaini.
Poshiyakotyaari tsika ikantapainta Jesucristo,
Pawapero rini irirori, temaita roisokerotawo roshiyakotyaari Pawa.
Ripakaanakero ipinkatharitzi, roshiyakotanakari imperataarewo, itzimapaintzi, roshiyakotapaakari ikantayetaga atziripaini.
Roshiyapaakari atziripaini, te ipinkatharitanai. Shiretha ikantapainta irojatzi ikamantakari ikentakoitakeri.
Iroowa opoñaantari Pawa ririiperokitakagairi Cristo, ipinkathariwentantaperotzi, ranaanakeri ikaatzi riwetsikaitakeri.
Ikowi Pawa maawoini impinkathaperotaiteri Jesús, onkantawetya tsikarika janta inampitaityaawo, inkiteki, kipatsiki, eejatzi otapinaki kipatsi.
Inkantayeetai maawoini: “¡Pinkathariperori rini Jesucristo!” Aripaitera ipinkathaitairi Pawa Ashitairi.
Roshiyari ootamentotsi kemisantzinkaripaini

Ari onkantyaari netakotanewo iyekiite. Tema pairani nisaikimotakemi janta, osheki pikemisantapiintakena. Ari pinkantairo eejatzi nisaikira intaina, pantapiintairo okaatzi nonkantemiri. Pinkamaiwentaiyaari Pawa rowawisaakoshiretantemiri, panteniri okaatzi ikowakaayetakemiri.
Tema Pawa iriitake kowashiretakaantatsiri, pantapiintantawori kameethari. Irijatzi Pawa antakaimirone.
Pantainiri Pawa maawoini kameethatatsiri, eero pikisawakaawentawo,
iro ompoñaantyaari eero itzimanta iita yakowentemine. Tema itomi Pawa pinayetzi, pipakagairo kaariperori, kameetha pisaikimotairi kenashiwaitainchari. Poshiyakotyaari kiteesheenkatakairori tsireniri.

Pinkyaaryoowentanairo pikemakotakerowa ñaantsi, iroowa pañaashiretantaiyaari. Arika pinkyaaryoowentero, antawo nonthaamentemi ripiyairika Cristo, tema te natsipetashiwaityaawo nokenkithatakotakemirowa riñaane Pawa.

Onkantawetya rowamaawentaitenawo nokemisantakagaimira, osheki nonkimoshirete. Ari pinkantaiyaari eerokapaini, pinkimoshirewentaina. Arika rowamagaitakena, oshiyaiyaawo nañaamento rapaataitziro riraitziri risaitaitziniriri piratsi ritagaitziniriri Pawa.
Iroowa pinkimoshirewentantenari eerokapaini iroñaaka.
Timoteo eejatzi Epafrodito
Iriirika kowaintsine Awinkatharite Jesús, ari piñaakero intsipaite notyaantemiri Timoteo. Tema arika ripiyake, inkamantapaina tsika pikanta pisaikaiyini janta, iroowa nonkimoshiretantyaari.
Tekaatsi itsipa oshiyaarine Timoteo, osheki ikowake ineshironkatemi ikemetaakenaga naaka.
Tzimawetacha itsipa, apatziro roshiretawo oitarika ikowiri irirori, te roshiretakotawo ikowakaantziri Cristo Jesús.

Iro kantacha, piyotaiyini eeroka kameetha ikanta risaikimotakena Timoteo, iri kyaaryootaintsi itsipatakena nokenkithatakotzirowa Kameethari Ñaantsi. Osheki ramitakotakena, oshiyawaitakawo iriime notomi.
Arika niyotake jimpe inkantaitena, iriira notyaantemiri janta.
Aamaane nokantakeri Awinkatharite intsipaiterika inkantakayaawo, naakaga jatashitemine janta.
Iri netawakya notyaantaimiri iyeki Epafrodito, potyaantakenari pairani. Osheki ineshironkatapaakena. Roshiyari irirori owayeri, iriitake tsipatapiintakenari nokenkithatakaantzi.
Jirika Epafrodito, osheki ikenkithashiretakotakemi, antawoite ikowake iñaapaimi, tema riyotake pikemakotakeri imantsiyawaitake.

Ari ikantawetaka imantsiyatzi, iroowetaincha inkameme. Iro kantacha ineshironkatakeri Pawa, retsiyatakotakagairi. Te apatziro ineshironkatakeri irirori rimatzitakena eejatzi naaka, te ikowakaanawo nimaperotya nowashiretakoperotyaari arika inkamimotakena.
Irootake notyaantantaimiriri intsipaite janta, ompoñaantyaari pinkimoshireperotantyaari arika piñaawairi, eero nowashireperotanta naaka eejatzi.
Kimoshire pinkantawentawaiyaari, tema pirentzitawakaanaatya pikemisantairira Awinkatharite. Pimpinkathatapiintairi ikaatzi oshiyariri irirori.
Tema kamawetaka irirori, ikamaitanakawo rantayetziro ikowakairiri Cristo. Rishinewentakawo ramitakowaitakena, te retakowaita irirori, oshiyawaitakawo eerokame amitakotenane jaka.
